context: WebGL performance tech demo — 1M-point scatterplot with 6 Gaussian clusters, brush-to-histogram interaction, FPS counter, and Canvas 2D fallback toggle
first_impression: Clean and technically impressive with soft, density-blended cluster blobs, but reads as a capable engineering demo rather than a designed visualization
what_works: Deliberate use of Paul Tol's colorblind-safe palette (not schemeCategory10) is a genuine design choice that shows intent; the inset 2D histogram panel and point-dimming brush interaction add real analytical utility and feel responsive
what_doesnt: Axis labels are literally 'X' and 'Y' — placeholder-level text that undermines any sense of a data story; the FPS display, checkbox, and subtitle are typographically undifferentiated from one another, creating a flat information hierarchy in the chrome
